basis: Authorizes ONE fresh 3,000-step Medumba GENERALISATION training run cm-pilot-byvgen-2026-001 (7,200 s ceiling = $3.20 worst case), job 2 of 3, inside a $6.40 additional-runtime cap of which $0.13 is used. Trains from the UNADAPTED BASE on data version byvgen1: 2,895 Medumba training clips from 64 speakers (4.4895 h), with 15 speakers held out entirely by the frozen rule sha256('byv-genz-2026/'+speaker_id) ascending. THE COMPARATOR IS ALREADY MEASURED: job b5-arm2-score-base-byvgen-2026-001 (294 s, $0.13) scored the same unadapted base this run starts from, on the same frozen 1,346-row manifest sha 08c959df. Baseline tone-sensitive CER: G2 41.57, G1 45.02, G4 46.92. The preregistered band, fixed before any job, therefore resolves to: IMPROVES iff candidate G2 <= 39.57 AND the speaker-clustered 95% CI excludes 0. Held identical to the capacity probe: image dcd401132653, seed 20260904, base init, LoRA r16/alpha32/dropout0.05, LR 1e-4, batch 2 x accum 8, temperature 0, KD off, raw training input. Changed: MANIFEST_VERSION byvgen1, MAX_STEPS 3000, CHECKPOINT_EVERY 250, and AUDIO_CAP_HOURS 1 -> 8 because the pool is 4.49 h and the old cap would have silently truncated it to about a fifth via the deterministic hash-ordered subsample. EXPLORATORY: the primary endpoint is 89 rows from 12 speakers with about 61% of the weight on one speaker. Per-speaker changes are reported alongside every pooled figure. A missed threshold is reported as 'criterion not met', NEVER as 'Medumba cannot improve'. 'Unseen' means excluded from THIS adaptation run; the base model's original pretraining exposure is unknown. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: single-language LoRA merged into a 15-language export; nothing may be promoted, registered or served. No TEST scoring, no serving change, no retry, no follow-on.
